concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage / plan.md:Task Ordering step 6 (T014b)
concerns.text: Plan element with no covering task: the plan's step 6 'State Update (T014b): Update state/ YAML with hashes' and Constitution Principle V's 'Update Mechanism' (state/projects/PROJ-533-...yaml updated immediately after every successful download and checksum computation) have no task in T001–T012. No task writes or updates the state YAML artifact_hashes, so this plan/constitution element cannot be satisfied.

FR-001 requires datasets from 'UCI Machine Learning Repository AND OpenML', but T002 fetches exclusively via sklearn fetch_openml / OpenML API. The UCI half of FR-001 has no covering task; either add UCI sourcing to T002 or record a documented narrowing of FR-001 (also flagged CRITICAL/HIGH in the analyze report — from the coverage lens it is an uncovered half of a MUST requirement).

The spec's TestResult entity lists Mann-Whitney U as a test type, but no task implements or tests it, and contracts/test_result.schema.yaml's enum omits it. This is an uncovered spec element (or a stale spec element) — it needs either a covering task or a spec amendment; as written an implementer cannot satisfy the entity definition.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T012 vs plan.md:Project Structure (results/type1_error_results.csv, power_results.csv, sensitivity_results.csv)
concerns.text: Plan/data-model storage-strategy elements results/type1_error_results.csv, results/power_results.csv, results/sensitivity_results.csv have no producing task — tasks write results/type1_error/*.json, results/power/*.json, results/aggregated/sensitivity_analysis.json instead. The divergence is defensible, but the plan's declared output files are uncovered; add a note in T012 (or the coverage table) explicitly superseding the plan's flat-file layout so the handoff traces cleanly.
